Name: Main Controller
Description: Main microcontroller for AI processing, navigation logic, camera control, and display management. Chosen for compact size and integrated Wi-Fi/Bluetooth.

Name: Head Tracking IMU
Description: 6-axis IMU (accelerometer and gyroscope) for precise head movement and orientation tracking, essential for AR display stability and user interaction.

Name: Navigation GPS
Description: GPS module providing location data for augmented reality navigation features.

Name: AR Micro Display
Description: Compact micro-OLED display for projecting augmented reality overlays directly into the user's field of view.

Name: First Person Camera
Description: High-resolution camera module for capturing first-person perspective video and images, enabling AI vision applications.

Name: Voice Command Mic
Description: Electret microphone with amplifier for capturing user voice commands and ambient audio.

Name: Audio Feedback Speaker
Description: Small 8-ohm speaker for providing audio feedback, navigation cues, and voice assistant responses.

Name: LiPo Battery 3.7V
Description: Rechargeable Lithium Polymer battery, providing portable power for all smart glasses components.

Name: LiPo Charging Circuit
Description: Module for safe charging of the LiPo battery via USB-C or micro-USB.

Name: 5V Buck Converter
Description: Step-down converter to provide stable 5V power from the battery for components requiring 5V.

Name: Left Input Button
Description: Small tactile button for user input, located on the left side of the glasses frame.

Name: Right Input Button
Description: Small tactile button for user input, located on the right side of the glasses frame.

Name: Smart Glasses Frame
Description: Main frame for smart glasses, integrating bays and mounts for all electronics.

Name: Left Temple Hinge
Description: Small spring hinge for glasses temple, attaches to the left side of the frame.

Name: Right Temple Hinge
Description: Small spring hinge for glasses temple, attaches to the right side of the frame.

Name: Adjustable Nose Pads
Description: Set of two silicone adjustable nose pads for comfortable fit.

Name: MCU Mount
Description: Custom mount for the MCU (ESP32/Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W) inside the frame.

Name: IMU Housing
Description: Small housing for the IMU sensor to be integrated into the frame.

Name: GPS Module Mount
Description: Mounting bracket for the GPS module within the glasses frame.

Name: Micro-OLED Display Bezel
Description: Custom bezel and mount for the micro-OLED display, integrated into the frame near the eye.

Name: Camera Module Housing
Description: Housing for the high-resolution camera module, positioned for first-person view.

Name: Microphone Grille
Description: Small grille for the microphone, integrated into the frame.

Name: Speaker Grille
Description: Small grille for the speaker, integrated into the temple of the frame.

Name: Battery Bay Cover
Description: Removable cover for the LiPo battery and charging circuit bay.

Name: Push Button Caps
Description: Small caps for external push buttons or touch sensors.

Name: Small Frame Screws
Description: Tiny screws for attaching hinges and securing small components to the frame.

Name: Component Mounting Screws
Description: Small screws for mounting internal 3D-printed parts and electrical components.
